content.en: A notice from the staff of Jinlan Pavilion: Recent disappearances have occurred frequently on the road ahead leading to the stage.
content.zh: 金兰观工作人员提醒您，前方通往戏台的路段近期人口失踪事件频发。

content.en: To maintain order during the festival and ensure everyone’s safety, all visitors and staff must follow the rules below.
content.zh: 为保障大会期间的正常秩序与人员安全，请所有游客及工作人员遵守以下规则。

content.en: 1. If you leave the street ahead and later find yourself entering the same street again, stay calm and observe your surroundings.
content.zh: 1.若您在离开前方街道后，发现自己再次进入相同街道，请保持冷静注意观察。

content.en: Follow the rules, and enjoy the festival. Everyone at Jinlan Pavilion wishes you a pleasant time at the Yuntai Festival.
content.zh: 遵守规则，享受大会。金兰观全体人员，祝愿您在芸台大会期间游玩愉快。

content.en: The writing in the middle is very blurry. I can’t make it out.
content.zh: 中间的字迹很模糊，看不清了。

content.en: 2. According to survivor testimony, the street you pass through the first time is absolutely safe. Use it as your reference.
content.zh: 2.经幸存者证言，您第一次通过的街道为绝对安全的，可以此为参照。

content.en: 3. If you notice any abnormalities on the street, turn around immediately and leave to the left.
content.zh: 3.如果您发现街道中存在有异常现象，请立刻转身，向左离开街道。

content.en: 4. If everything seems normal, continue forward and head right toward the stage.
content.zh: 4.如果街道中一切正常，请继续前进，向右前往戏台方向。

content.en: 5. This street is only about a hundred meters long. If you find it stretching far into the distance, please…
content.zh: 5.本条街道仅有约百米长，若您发现街道延申至极远方向，请......
